summary: Completed E2E testing of EMERGENT Diagnostic Hub redesign with Cinematic Modern Noir aesthetic. All 8 backend tests pass. Frontend tested: Hero page (badge, headline, CTAs, stats, 3-layer model, footer), UserForm (5 role options with icons, form validation, navigation), Quiz (progress bar, scenario display, options, back navigation), Navbar (logo, progress steps, CTA). All visual elements match design spec with glassmorphism effects and pill-shaped buttons.
critical_code_review_comments: Quiz page correctly redirects to /diagnose if no user in localStorage (security feature)
Design implementation matches spec: #030303 background, Blue (#3B82F6) and Amber (#F59E0B) accents
Glassmorphism cards have backdrop-blur effect working properly
seed_data_creation: Test users created via API during pytest execution
context_for_next_testing_agent: Tested features: Hero (all sections), UserForm (role selection + form + validation), Quiz (questions, options, navigation). Backend APIs: /api/health, /api/user/create, /api/quiz/generate-report, /api/report/{session_id}, /api/coach/chat, /api/email/send-report - all working. Visual design uses Manrope font for headings, Inter for body text. Animations include fadeInUp, slideUp on page elements.
